title: Could You Tell Me Where...?

pre.en: Who was the man in the lift?
pre.zh: 电梯里的那位老先生是谁？
options: A new developer on Chen's team
The boss of the whole company

intro: 小陈第一次去伦敦办公室，在新大楼里找不到会议室，于是在电梯里向一位老先生问路。读的时候留意间接疑问句：Could you tell me where … is?、Do you know if …?、He asked me what … 把问题装进另一句话里，语序要变回陈述句。结尾有个小意外。

sentences.en: So, after two months of video calls, I finally went to our London office in person.
sentences.zh: 是这样，视频通话了两个月，我终于亲自去了一趟伦敦办公室。

sentences.en: I was still yawning after the early train, and it was raining, of course.
sentences.zh: 坐了早班火车，我还在打哈欠，而且不出所料，天在下雨。

sentences.en: The company had just moved to a new building, and it was a maze.
sentences.zh: 公司刚搬进一栋新楼，楼里跟迷宫似的。

sentences.en: My first meeting was about to start, and I didn't know where room 4B was.
sentences.zh: 第一个会马上就要开了，可我不知道 4B 会议室在哪儿。

sentences.en: "I'm definitely going to be late," I thought.
sentences.zh: 「这下肯定要迟到了，」我心想。

sentences.en: There was a friendly older man in the lift, so I asked him.
sentences.zh: 电梯里有位和气的老先生，我就问了他。

sentences.en: "Excuse me, could you tell me where room 4B is?"
sentences.zh: 「打扰一下，您能告诉我 4B 会议室在哪儿吗？」

sentences.en: "I have no idea," he said with a smile.
sentences.zh: 「完全不知道，」他笑着说。

sentences.en: "But it's probably on the fourth floor."
sentences.zh: 「不过多半在四楼。」

sentences.en: We headed for the fourth floor together.
sentences.zh: 我们一起直奔四楼。

sentences.en: He was easy to talk to, and we soon struck up a conversation.
sentences.zh: 他很好聊，我们很快就聊开了。

sentences.en: On the way, he asked me what I was working on.
sentences.zh: 路上，他问我在做什么。

sentences.en: Then he asked whether the team had got started on the new app.
sentences.zh: 又问团队是不是已经开始做新 App 了。

sentences.en: He also wanted to know if the coffee machine was any good.
sentences.zh: 他还想知道咖啡机好不好用。

sentences.en: But when we got there, there was no 4B.
sentences.zh: 可到了四楼，根本没有 4B。

sentences.en: "Do you know if there's a map at reception?" I asked.
sentences.zh: 「您知道前台有没有地图吗？」我问。

sentences.en: So we turned back, and somehow we ended up in the car park.
sentences.zh: 于是我们往回走，结果不知怎么的，走到了停车场。

sentences.en: By coincidence, he was going to the same meeting.
sentences.zh: 真巧，他要去的也是这个会。

sentences.en: He said getting lost was a good way to get to know people.
sentences.zh: 他说，迷路是认识人的好办法。

sentences.en: "Have you seen the new kitchen yet?"
sentences.zh: 「新茶水间你去过了吗？」

sentences.en: "I'll show you around after lunch."
sentences.zh: 「午饭后我带你四处转转。」

sentences.en: At a quarter past ten, we finally found 4B.
sentences.zh: 十点一刻，我们终于找到了 4B。

sentences.en: Rachel stood up.
sentences.zh: Rachel 站了起来。

sentences.en: "Oh good, Chen — I see you've already met our CEO."
sentences.zh: 「太好了，小陈——看来你已经见过我们的 CEO 了。」

sentences.en: The CEO laughed.
sentences.zh: CEO 笑了。

sentences.en: "Don't worry, it's my first day in this building too."
sentences.zh: 「别担心，今天也是我第一天来这栋楼。」

cards.note: if you do something in person, you go somewhere or meet someone yourself, not by phone or online
cards.tip: 反义是 online、on a call、by email；「见到本人」可以说 meet sb in person。
cards.example: It's easier to explain this in person than on Slack.

cards.note: 也能当名词：give a big yawn（打了个大哈欠）。
常用来形容一个地方很难找路：The hospital is a maze.
to be going to happen or do something very soon
cards.tip: 后面接动词原形；比 be going to 更「马上」，所以不和具体时间连用：不说 I'm about to leave at six。
cards.example: I was about to leave when the client called.

cards.note: to not know something at all
cards.tip: 比 I don't know 语气重；后面可以接 wh- 从句，用陈述语序：I have no idea where it is。
cards.example: I have no idea why the build failed.

cards.note: to go towards a place
cards.tip: head 在这里是动词；问别人去哪儿可以说 Where are you heading?
cards.example: After the meeting, we headed for the pub.

cards.zh: （和陌生人）攀谈起来；搭起话来
cards.note: to start talking to someone you don't know
cards.tip: strike 的过去式和过去分词都是 struck；跟谁聊用 with：strike up a conversation with sb。
cards.example: I struck up a conversation with the person next to me at the conference.

cards.note: while you are going somewhere
cards.tip: 去某地的路上是 on the way to + 地点；home 前面不加 to：on the way home。in the way 是「挡路」，别混。
cards.example: Can you pick up some milk on the way home?

cards.note: to spend time doing, making or improving something
to begin doing something
cards.tip: 开始做什么用 on：get started on the new app；英式英语的过去分词是 got，美式常用 gotten。
cards.example: Let's get started — we only have half an hour.

cards.note: 多用在疑问句和否定句里：Is the film any good? / The map wasn't any good.
说「在前台」常不加冠词：Ask at reception. 前台接待员是 receptionist。
to return the way you came, before you reach the place you were going to
to be in a place or situation in the end, often without planning it
英式说法，美式说 parking lot。
by chance, in a surprising way that was not planned
to become unable to find your way
to spend time with someone so that you learn more about them
cards.tip: know 是状态，get to know 是「慢慢熟起来」的过程；初次见面说 meet，不说 know：Nice to meet you。
cards.example: It took me a few months to get to know my new team.

cards.zh: 带某人参观；带某人四处转转
cards.note: to take someone to see the different parts of a place
cards.tip: 后面可以加地点：show sb around the office；英式英语也说 show sb round。
cards.example: Our office manager showed me around on my first day.

cards.zh: 首席执行官；公司一把手
cards.note: chief executive officer 的缩写，按字母读 C-E-O。
